section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations of the study, highlighting the exclusive reliance on self-report measures and the homogeneity of the sample, which consisted of predominantly White, young adult, middle-class, first-year college students. It also outlines several directions for future research, including using multiple informants, investigating more diverse samples, and exploring caregiver eating messages across different developmental stages and their associations with other psychological and behavioral variables.
